binding_limit: dev37 has 4 Not AD donors (inner-fold training 2-3)
method: GEO series matrices and file lists, NCBI E-utilities search (254 human AD single-cell/nucleus series screened by title), CELLxGENE curation index + HTTPS range reads of obs only, Europe PMC full texts, Springer supplementary tables, Synapse REST access requirements. No expression matrix was read.
download_budget_note: About 95 MB were transferred in total (CELLxGENE index 9.9 MB, obs range reads about 55 MB of which about 35 MB were wasted on three reads that hit their byte cap, one 19 MB Springer workbook to extract Gerrits Table S1, GEO metadata about 4 MB, papers about 2 MB). This exceeds the about-50 MB guidance; nothing larger than 20 MB was a single file, and only small tables were kept (smoke_r3/data_inventory is about 2 MB).

feasibility.label_mapping: Only the MADRC set (and 9 Gerrits donors) publish the Thal-based A score, so only they map exactly onto the 4 ADNC levels. Every other open set gives Braak (+/- CERAD or a Braak amyloid stage): from SEA-AD's own cross-tab, Not AD predicted from Braak+CERAD is right for only ~56% of donors.
feasibility.batch_problem: Different region, sorting (FANS NeuN-/OLIG2- vs unsorted), chemistry (v2/v3), reference (3.0.0 vs 2020-A vs pre-mRNA builds), lab and age. No published number was found that directly compares cross-dataset microglia pseudobulk differences with stage effects; in this study the within-SEA-AD High-minus-Not-AD contrast is not even reproducible between donor halves (split-half 0.135), so any cohort offset larger than that would swamp it. This was not measured here (no counts read).
feasibility.cheapest_real_measurement: Download GSE264648_counts_microglia.rds.gz (42 MB; MTG for 15 donors) and compare its MTG microglia pseudobulk to dev37 TRAIN donors' pseudobulk on the shared Ensembl axis: cohort offset vs stage contrast magnitude, before any training decision.

can_do_now_open: 1. MADRC (GSE268599): ITG libraries of the 31 donors that have ITG (7 Not AD, 5 Low, 6 Intermediate, 13 High by published ABC). Same 36,601 gene axis as SEA-AD. Re-annotate microglia with the study's train-only type classifier; add a dataset/region indicator to the condition vector; use as additional TRAINING donors only, keep SEA-AD MTG held-out donors as the only evaluation. About 2-3 GB transient download, needs a protocol amendment (it adds non-SEA-AD counts).

2. Before that, measure the cohort offset cheaply on GSE264648 microglia (42 MB, MTG) as above; if the offset dwarfs the stage contrast, use external donors only for external validation of stage direction (e.g. MADRC ITG High-minus-NotAD vs the generator's MTG contrast), not for training.
3. Gerrits 2021 (2-3 Not AD-like, 147k microglia, occipital) as a second external validation set; lower priority because of region and age.
needs_agreement: ROSMAP (Mathys/Sun/Green; ~189 NIA-Reagan non-AD) and PsychAD pathology: AD Knowledge Portal DUC signed by an institutional official.
Prater 2023 PU.1 microglia (10 ADNC 0-1 controls, same UW staging scale): Synapse 'PU.1 Data Use Statement'.

cellxgene_census.route: CELLxGENE Census (tiledbsoma) = all primary-data CELLxGENE datasets on one Ensembl gene axis with raw counts
verified: CELLxGENE index (2,271 public datasets, 2026-11-11): 211 human datasets list microglia; AD-relevant ones listed in cxg/cxg_microglia_datasets.txt

Standard donor fields are donor_id, disease (MONDO), development_stage, sex, self_reported_ethnicity, tissue, assay. Braak/CERAD/Thal are NOT schema fields; they exist only as author columns in some datasets (Layer4, fresh myeloid, Leng, CSF1R) and are not exposed through Census queries.
Census keeps is_primary_data=True cells: PsychAD myeloid (09642770) and SEA-AD Microglia-PVM subsets are non-primary duplicates; their cells reach Census through the cohort / whole-taxonomy objects.

approximate_yield_microglia_donors_by_op.SEA-AD MTG + DLPFC: 89 / 83 donors, disease = dementia or normal (cognitive, not ADNC); ADNC is in SEA-AD's own open metadata, not in Census
approximate_yield_microglia_donors_by_op.PsychAD (MSSM + RADC + HBCC): about 1,494 donors; myeloid census: Control 470, AD 560 (aged controls with >=100 myeloid nuclei: 141)
approximate_yield_microglia_donors_by_op.PD multi-region atlas 2026: 101 donors (PD / normal), MTG among regions, no AD staging
approximate_yield_microglia_donors_by_op.others: Olah 17, Leng 10, CSF1R 8, Layer4 46, fresh myeloid 137, HVS 61 young neurosurgical

cellxgene_census.verdict: Census is a good harmonised route for 'normal vs AD' labels and a common gene axis, but NOT for neuropathological stage: none of the Census-standard fields carries Braak, CERAD, Thal or ADNC, and the large contributors (PsychAD, SEA-AD) label disease clinically. Not installed or queried directly (cellxgene_census not present; would need a new package); counts come from per-dataset obs reads and the CELLxGENE curation index.
